description: Complete kerminal-only adaptation: marketplace mechanism removed, kerminal mem adapter, session identity (kerminal_default), workflow-state breadcrumb on context pulls.
changelog: **Complete kerminal-only adaptation.** Marketplace/registry template fetching removed (offline init); `trellis mem` reads Kerminal sessions (~/.kerminal/sessions, Codex-rollout format); pull-based session identity persists the active-task pointer under the `kerminal_default` key; `get_context.py` appends the per-turn workflow-state breadcrumb; dead multi-platform cli_adapter.py retired; uninstall scrub registry collapsed to AGENTS.md; docs/CI/packaging aligned.
notes: No migrations required. Install: `npm install -g trellis-kerminal`
